source.description: A reviewed six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet showing one consistent lobster progressing from pale construction to a restrained graphite and coral colored-pencil finish.
source.notes: Keep one full lobster in a slightly angled top view, its head toward the upper right, one larger claw raised, one smaller claw held lower, exactly seven visible walking legs with one front leg hidden behind the raised claw, two long antennae, a segmented abdomen, five-part tail fan, shell markings, and one broken shadow stable. No plate, food, ocean scene, bubbles, extra animal, text, labels, arrows, numbers, signature, watermark, or final-only anatomy.

process_strategy: Lock the lobster's diagonal center axis, carapace, abdomen, tail fan, two claw routes, seven visible leg routes, the raised claw's reserved occlusion footprint, antennae, and shadow in pale construction; establish every visible contour and joint before texture or color; then add only graphite, coral-red, muted orange, and cream pencil to the existing shell shapes.

final_elements.name: diagonal axis, carapace oval, abdomen blocks, claw routes, seven visible leg routes, antennae, tail fan, and shadow guides
final_elements.description: Pale graphite construction fixes one angled top view, the head and body proportions, one raised and one lower claw, seven visible walking legs with one front leg occluded by the raised claw, two antennae, a five-part tail fan, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: complete carapace, two claws, segmented abdomen silhouette, and five-part tail fan
final_elements.description: The outside contour turns the construction into one readable lobster with asymmetrical claws and a broad tail fan.

final_elements.name: two eyes, two long antennae, exactly seven visible walking legs, shell bands, and claw joints
final_elements.description: The eyes, antennae, seven visible walking legs, abdomen bands, and claw joints establish the lobster's recognizable anatomy while the raised claw naturally hides one front leg.

final_elements.name: shell spots, joint creases, tail-fan veins, contour hatching, and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Sparse shell texture and directional hatch marks clarify the hard shell and ground the pose without over-rendering it.

final_elements.name: graphite shell values, coral-red and muted-orange pencil, cream highlights, and deeper shadow tone
final_elements.description: Restrained colored pencil separates the shell planes and claws while visible graphite and open paper keep the drawing attainable.

rejection_checks: The same diagonal top-view lobster, head direction, carapace size, claw routes, leg routes, antennae, tail fan, crop, and shadow footprint must persist through all six panels.

Exactly one lobster, two claws, seven visible walking legs with one front leg consistently hidden behind the raised claw, two antennae, one segmented abdomen, and one five-part tail fan must appear before the final panel and persist.
No plate, food styling, ocean scene, bubbles, extra animal, word, label, arrow, number, signature, watermark, or final-only anatomy may appear.

The finish must retain visible graphite and colored-pencil grain rather than photoreal shell rendering, glossy poster polish, or vector-like linework, and every dark pre-final line must survive unless it is a pale erasable guide.
